item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:40 HKT 24/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak over Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be very hot during the day. Showers triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the next few days. Tropical Cyclone Co-May will linger over the northern part of Luzon, and then move towards the seas east of Taiwan. There may be another area of low pressure over the weekend. The broad trough of low pressure is expected to move northwards towards the coast of southern China, and bring unsettled weather to the region in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Francisco will move across the seas in the vicinity of Ryukyu Islands today and tomorrow, then move towards the coast of southeastern China.
